title: SAGE3
description: Open-source, NSF-funded collaborative visualization platform enabling users to share media, data, dashboards, and code across laptops, display walls, and meeting spaces. Core developer contributing to architecture, features, and real-time collaboration.

title: CycloneDX SBOM Visualizer
description: 3D web application for visualizing Software Bill of Materials, allowing users to interactively explore component hierarchies, dependencies, and vulnerabilities in a spatial environment.

title: Destiny Class CyberCANOE
description: 3D web application for visualizing Software Bill of Materials, allowing users to interactively explore component hierarchies, dependencies, and vulnerabilities in a spatial environment.

title: Hawaii State Energy Office Projects
description: VR simulations for the Hawaii State Energy Office visualizing solar and wind projects on Oahu. Managed student team development using Unity and Oculus to help stakeholders understand land-use impacts.

title: DynaCOVE
description: Real-time data visualization streaming tool for web, VR, AR, and mobile devices. Designed for rendering large datasets on underpowered hardware in partnership with Oceanit (SBIR project).

title: HAVEN
description: Angular/Firebase web application visualizing Hawaii's energy resource interdependencies for the Hawaii State Energy Office. Interactive data visualization platform for energy planning and analysis.

title: Tatooine
description: A hybrid reality environment simulating the planet Tatooine from the Star Wars franchise. Users explore a downed X-Wing fighter, use a light saber, and move objects with the force. This was develped using Unity3D and assets were borrowed from Star Wars Battlefront.
